reason: With the wedding coming I do need the house painted, and I will let them do a site visit, but only as one of my three quotes. Writing 'finishes by the agreed date' costs them nothing, and a fixed ₹78,000 with no room to bargain means I cannot check it against the per-square-foot rate my local contractor gives me.
objection: Every painting outfit promises a date, and then the crew vanishes for a week to another job halfway through. Nothing here says what happens to me if they miss the date before my relatives arrive.
would_change_my_mind: A written penalty for every day they run late, taken off the bill, and the balance paid only after the work is finished and I have checked it, with the per-square-foot breakdown shown so I can compare.
